summary.headline: Morning sun, 1 to 3 hours a day
summary.subline: From about 10:45 until about 12:45. Most in October, least in June.

advice:
Verdict: A short late-morning to midday sun spot that is sunnier in autumn and winter, peaking in October with 3.0 hours and dipping in June with 1.1 hours.
Blocked by: your own white and blue wall and building to the south, costing about 0.6 to 0.7 hours a day in winter.
Good for: shade-loving bougainvillea, midday tea out of high summer heat, drying herbs gently
Not for: sunbathing, tomato growing, winter solar heating
Tip: Put seating where the midday gap hits and move a pet bed there around noon.
